title: chore(examples): handle linting issues in e-commerce-umd example
body:
**Summary**

This PR updates some files to handle linting rules that were introduced recently.

Additionally the example was merged in between a release cycle, so it missed on updating its dependency version to instantsearch.js, this is fixed now.
